description: This file defines the ErrorHandler class in the Slim PHP framework, responsible for handling application errors by rendering appropriate responses in various formats based on the Accept header. It includes methods for determining content type, selecting renderers, logging errors, and generating error responses.

classes.name: ErrorHandler
classes.description: Default Slim application error handler that manages rendering of error responses in various formats, logging, and error management.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Handles the error by setting properties, logging if enabled, and generating the error response.

methods.name: forceContentType
methods.description: Sets a specific content type for all error responses.

methods.name: determineStatusCode
methods.description: Determines HTTP status code based on the exception type and request method.

methods.name: determineContentType
methods.description: Selects the appropriate response content type based on the Accept header.

methods.name: determineRenderer
methods.description: Resolves the appropriate error renderer based on the content type.

methods.name: registerErrorRenderer
methods.description: Registers a new error renderer for a specific content type.

methods.name: setDefaultErrorRenderer
methods.description: Sets the default error renderer and its content type.

methods.name: setLogErrorRenderer
methods.description: Sets the renderer used for logging errors.

methods.name: writeToErrorLog
methods.description: Logs the error using the configured logger.

methods.name: logError
methods.description: Wraps the logger's error method to facilitate testing.

methods.name: respond
methods.description: Builds and returns the error response with appropriate headers and body.
